content.title: Add funds to an account
content.description: Where the live Bank Demo exposes deposit, add-funds, or equivalent balance-increase functionality, an authenticated user can initiate that funding action with a monetary amount that obeys the product's numeric and business rules, commit the increase to the correct balance, have the result reflected in transaction history where supported, and avoid false balances or completed transactions when the operation fails.
content.value: Supports balance increases without corrupting account or transaction state.
criteria: supported users can initiate the product's balance-increase operation and the amount must obey accepted numeric and business rules
successful funding updates the correct balance and transaction history, while failed funding does not create a false balance or completed transaction
